_description: Ling-3.2-air — inclusionAI's (Ant Group) 124B-total / 5.5B-ACTIVATED hybrid-linear MoE, the ling32air fleet family's first arm (added 2026-11-28, round 13; the llama.cpp arm uap-ling32air-server is the family's only arm: Basalt 0.5.7 has no bailing support — fixed 5-model roster; Strata 0.2.22's signed feed seq 136 ships shape engines only for hy4/inkling2/dsv41, no ling shape engine and no bailing in the engine itself; timbuksu's FLARE NVFP4 core targets a 96 GiB gb202 at 69.11 GiB loaded and cannot fit a 32 GB 5090 — llama.cpp b12600+ gained day-0 bailingmoe3, so llama.cpp is the only maintained fast local path). The model's class is the point: AA Intelligence Index v5.0.1 23, ranked #1 under 128B; Terminal-Bench 4.0 27%; AutomationBench-AA 15.7 -> 61 (the workflow-automation jump). Architecture: a 42-layer hybrid decoder — 35 KDA (Kimi Delta Attention) linear-attention layers + 7 Gated MLA layers (5:1) + 2 dense layers, 512 routed experts x top-8 + 1 shared per MoE layer, 157184 vocab, native image + video multimodality through the mmproj encoder, and MTP (multi-token prediction) draft layers in-pack. MIT license.
_engine: LLAMA.CPP ARM (uap-ling32air-server, installed 2026-11-28): llama.cpp b12814 (prebuilt ubuntu-cuda-13.5-x64, GPG-signed nightly; the moe-cache cross-backend fix + active bailingmoe3 fusion land), ggml CUDA verified on the 5090 (compute 12.0, 32199 MiB, driver 615.71.09). The pack — bartowski Ling-3.2-air Q4_K_M GGUF, 80.39 GB in 3 splits on the 4TB at /run/media/dammian/9100PRO-4TB-1/models/llamacpp/ling32air/ (per-file sha256 verified at download against the HF LFS oids, not a hand-copied manifest — the first manifest had a one-char transcription typo that false-fataled file 2; all four files re-verified mechanically against the HF API) + .ling32air-verified stamp — is the computed per-tensor layout at KLD 0.0922 vs the unquantized model where the standard layout gives 0.1186 (0.87x at equal size, measured on the same-arch Ling-3.0-flash-VL twin), imatrix calibrated on this model's own chat template with --parse-special; MTP layers at Q4_0 for draft speed; + mmproj-f16 (875 MB). Serve posture: --jinja (the GGUF's Bailing V3 template), --ctx-size 262144 (the native window), --parallel 1 (llama-server DEFAULTS TO 4 SLOTS without it, splitting the window 4-ways — the pin enforces the one-rail doctrine), --spec-type draft-mtp, --alias 'Ling-3.2-air Q4_K_M', --n-gpu-layers 99, --n-cpu-moe 35, --threads 16, port 8080. Memory map (probed at install): n-cpu-moe 32 OOMs at the MTP draft-context KV (288 MiB short with 10 GPU expert layers), 34 loads at 30.3/32.6 GiB (2.2 GiB free — tight for the vision workspace), 35 splits the difference: the card holds the dense/attention/KDA weights, the KV, the MTP head + the LAST 7 layers' experts at 28.4-28.7 GiB (~3.9 GiB free); the FIRST 35 layers' expert weights compute on the CPU (9950X3D) over mmap, page-cache resident — 5.5B active at Q4 is ~3.3 GB/token of reads, so decode is DRAM-bound. --n-cpu-moe is THE tuning knob; re-probe (alias probe, port 8099, read nvidia-smi) before changing. NO basalt-autotune wrapper — llama-server's slot model differs (single --parallel slot; the tuner key UAP_PARALLEL_LING32AIR is parked until a multi-slot need shows).
_model_comment: FINALIZED at the 2026-11-28 install smoke from the LIVE reads: engine /v1/models and the proxy /v1/models both list exactly 'Ling-3.2-air Q4_K_M' (the --alias sets the wire id; the quant tag rides it per the hy4/deepseek41 precedents). Requests must carry exactly this id; both proxy wires verified with it. Droid customModels and the opencode fleet entry carry the same id — updated together at the smoke.
_max_tokens_comment: The ADVERTISED output cap (mirrors the backends.json client_caps), NOT a measured engine clamp. The engine-family precedent (inkling2 measured its answer-room clamp at 32768 on its basalt arm; deepseek41's ladder is UNMEASURED) says the honest value needs a clamp measurement on THIS arm before trusting anything above ~32k. The smoke only ever sent max_tokens 4096/512, so the ladder stays UNMEASURED; 65536 is what clients advertise until that ladder runs. Re-measure before raising.
_sampling_comment: VENDOR-TRANSCRIBED from inclusionAI's model card (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20). The live /props on this llama-server build exposes NO engine defaults (temp/top_p/top_k all null), so there is nothing to measure against — the vendor values stand as the profile defaults, and the echo/tool/vision gates all ran at temperature 0 without incident. This family has never been tool-call-tuned on this box; re-tune with `uap tune` before deviating.
_stop_sequences_comment: CONFIRMED EMPTY at the 2026-11-28 smoke: every measured turn ended cleanly — echo/tool/struct/vision turns finish=stop or tool_calls on the engine and OpenAI proxy wire, end_turn on the anthropic proxy wire — with no explicit markers. The pack's own Bailing V3 chat template (--jinja) owns EOS. Carrying another family's marker would be transcription, not measurement.
_context_window_comment: THIS IS A PER-SESSION CAP, AND IT IS OPT-IN BY PROFILE HEADER (the family doctrine: a client that sends no x-uap-model-profile header gets the whole rail; factory/droid custom models cannot send it, so their listings carry maxContextLimit client-side at this cap). The arm serves ONE 262144-cell rail (the model's native window — a larger pool would invite positions beyond the trained window), and the cap sits at HALF of it, the inkling2 single-rail morning-posture doctrine: a session at cap leaves >= 2x headroom for the elastic caches and the prompt workspaces. Admission arithmetic is the same operator-accepted overcommit class as inkling2/qwen38/deepseek41. KDA keeps the KV small, so the rail itself is cheap; the cap exists for the caches, not the cells.
_thinking_comment: Native thinking, VENDOR DEFAULT ON (enable_thinking true in the model card). The DISABLE mechanism is now VERIFIED at the 2026-11-28 smoke: chat_template_kwargs {enable_thinking: false} suppresses thinking cleanly — reasoning_len=0, marker exact, finish=stop — on the direct engine wire AND through the proxy's OpenAI wire (the anthropic-wire echo also ran clean: end_turn, single text block, no thinking leak at default posture). The budget gotcha holds: the thinking phase CONSUMES the completion budget (a starved cap returns EMPTY content with finish=length). The reasoning field's exact shape at effort > 0 (server-side answer-room vs an on-wire reasoning field) stays UNVERIFIED — the smoke never ran an effort > 0 turn with a reasoning-field probe.

dynamic_temperature._comment: On retry, temp = max(floor, base_temp * decay^attempt). Reduces randomness for structured output.

tool_call_batching.system_prompt_suffix: When multiple tools are needed, call ALL of them in a single response. Do not call one tool and wait - emit all tool calls together.
tool_call_batching._comment: Carried from the engine-family default: the suffix was MEASURED on the inkling basalt arm (sequential emission without it, parallel with it, 2026-11-25). THIS arm's own multi-tool emission behavior is UNMEASURED — the install smoke verified a native single tool call (get_weather/Paris, clean arguments, finish=tool_calls, 2.2s); no multi-tool turn has been measured. Re-measure before removing the suffix.

concurrency._comment: ONE llama-server slot (--parallel 1 pinned in the unit: llama-server DEFAULTS TO 4 SLOTS otherwise, which would split the 262144 window 4-ways and break the one-rail doctrine — the live /props read confirmed total_slots 1 after the pin). One request decodes at a time — a second concurrent client queues at the proxy. The 80 GB pack splits its experts across GPU + CPU, so slots would multiply the CPU expert traffic per token; the tuner key is PARKED (no basalt-autotune wrapper on this arm — llama-server's slot model differs). PROXY_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT/UAP_MODEL_SLOTS follow this field; raise only with a measured multi-slot run.
concurrency._kv_shared_comment: One arm, one pool: the whole 262144-cell window is shared, not sliced — a session addresses the full rail.

server_optimization._kv_dtype_comment: llama-server default KV (untyped). KDA linear attention compresses most state into a fixed-size recurrent window, so only the 7 Gated MLA + 2 dense layers carry full KV — the rail is small without dtype tricks; no --cache-type-k/-v is set on the arm.
server_optimization._capacity_comment: The arm's full native window: --ctx-size 262144 in the unit; the live /props n_ctx read 262144 at the smoke. Context is cheap on this model (KDA), but the pool deliberately stops at the trained window — positions beyond 262144 are outside the model's window, unlike deepseek41 whose 1M window halved to 524288. The prompt-cache blocks grow with position into the memory the CPU expert tier leaves free.

speculative_decoding.draft_model: in-pack MTP layers (Q4_0 in this pack, stored in every bartowski ling quant for draft speed)
speculative_decoding._comment: MTP drafting via --spec-type draft-mtp: the model's own multi-token-prediction head drafts, llama.cpp verifies — output is the model's own. The /slots endpoint confirms speculative: true on the live arm. THIS arm's acceptance rate is UNMEASURED: the engine exposes no /metrics (HTTP 501 on this build) and the journal prints no acceptance stats, so draft_max stays null and the effective accept is inferable only from the decode band (~33-39 tok/s warm WITH MTP active; the pre-smoke plain-band estimate was 25-45, so MTP's contribution on this posture is small-to-unclear). A dedicated instrumented run (spec-diagnostics build or strace of the draft loop) is the only honest path to the number.

server_optimization._comment: The flags the arm actually runs with (unit uap-ling32air-server.service): --model Q4_K_M-00001-of-00003.gguf (split chain auto-detected), --mmproj mmproj-f16.gguf, --alias 'Ling-3.2-air Q4_K_M', --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080, --ctx-size 262144, --parallel 1, --spec-type draft-mtp, --jinja, --n-gpu-layers 99, --n-cpu-moe 35, --threads 16; Environment LD_LIBRARY_PATH carries the flat b12814 dir + the cudart-llama-b12814 redist dir (the bin tarball extracts FLAT into llama-b12814/ — no bin/ subdir).

measured._arm_comment: MEASURED LIVE at the 2026-11-28 install smoke (two full bench runs after the one-slot restart, consistent across runs): decode classes at 256 tokens / temp 0.7 / thinking suppressed — conv 37.1, prose 36.7, struct 39.3 tok/s (the struct sample is 19 tokens — the model answers short; the conv sample finished naturally at 227); first cold pass (page cache warming) read 30.7-35.6. Prefill ~600 tok/s to first token on the ~30K-word filler (TTFT ~50s across two fresh-prompt runs — the 35 CPU expert layers make prefill DRAM-bound TOO, so deep-PREFILL agent turns belong on other arms: deepseek41 reads 30K at 9.84s, five times faster); identical-prompt second run hit the prompt cache at 0.14s (the cache works; a rate needs a dedicated run). Echo gate (thinking suppressed) PASS 0.9s direct / 1.2s proxy OpenAI wire / 0.8s proxy anthropic wire; native single tool call PASS 2.2-2.3s; vision three-blue-discs PASS 1.6s COLD (the mmproj loads with the model at start — no first-image staging; modalities confirm native video too). NO 5090 anchor existed (the model was 5 days old; the FLARE table is a 96 GiB card): the honest pre-smoke band 25-45 plain / 50-80 MTP-effective landed HALF-RIGHT — decode measured at the plain band's middle WITH MTP active, not the MTP band. deepseek41 (50.8 conv) outranks this arm on decode AND prefill; ling's edge is the 131072 session cap at KLD 0.0922 quality (4th-best in the fleet), native vision+video, and the #1-under-128B class. VRAM 28.4-28.7 / 32.6 GiB at serve; the 80 GB pack sits in page cache (RAM ~86 GiB buff/cache beside the desktop background). Null fields are the measurements the smoke could not take: MTP acceptance (no metrics endpoint), prefix-cache hit rate, sustained load, and the output-clamp ladder (see _max_tokens_comment).

routing._comment: Route through the anthropic-proxy, NOT the engine port directly — the proxy applies the tool/finalize guardrails and, via this profile, the per-session context window that clients size their history to. Clients select this profile with the header 'x-uap-model-profile: ling32air' (or a uap_model_profile body param); the profile map resolves the wire id below here for clients that cannot send the header. Both proxy wires verified at the 2026-11-28 smoke (openai + anthropic, marker-exact echoes).

_vision_comment: CONFIRMED at the 2026-11-28 smoke: the three-blue-discs probe answered 3 blue circles in 1.6s COLD — the mmproj-f16 encoder (875 MB) loads with the model at start (--mmproj in the unit ExecStart), so there is NO first-image staging cost (unlike the hy4 arm's 17s). /props modalities: vision TRUE, video TRUE (native temporal support — probe only if the operator asks), audio false.
